title: IPv4 Addressing Basics Quiz
description: Check your understanding of IPv4 addresses, subnet masks, classes and private ranges.

questions.prompt: Which of these is a valid private IPv4 address?
questions.explanation: 172.16.0.0 – 172.31.255.255 is one of the three RFC 1918 private ranges (along with 10.0.0.0/8 and 192.168.0.0/16).

questions.prompt: What is the default subnet mask for a Class C address?
questions.explanation: Class C uses the first three octets for the network, so the default mask is 255.255.255.0 (/24).

questions.prompt: How many usable host addresses are there in a /28 subnet?
questions.explanation: A /28 has 2^4 = 16 addresses; subtracting the network and broadcast addresses leaves 14 usable hosts.

questions.prompt: Which address is the broadcast address of 192.168.10.0/24?
questions.explanation: The broadcast address has all host bits set to 1, making it the last address in the subnet: 192.168.10.255.
